name: fashion-market
description: Fashion Market: a season of fashion retail in a market you build, simulated one shopper at a time as an agent-based model in R (webR + NetLogoR), running in the browser.

scripts.test: node --test tools/test-sw.mjs && Rscript tools/test-shims.R && Rscript tools/test-fashion.R

comment: Dev-only: the app itself is static files. vendor/codemirror.js is committed, so nothing here is needed to run or deploy the app.
